coaches.name: Renee Fleming
coaches.specialties: Sound healing · Reiki · Breathwork · Meditation · Yin yoga · NLP
coaches.bio:
Renee Fleming is a holistic wellness practitioner dedicated to creating safe, nurturing spaces where people can reconnect with themselves, restore balance, and experience deep inner healing.

With qualifications in Sound Healing, Reiki, Breathwork, Meditation, Yin Yoga, and Neuro-Linguistic Programming (NLP), Renee brings together a unique blend of evidence-informed techniques and heart-centred practices to support the mind, body, and spirit.

Whether guiding a calming meditation, facilitating transformational breathwork, offering Reiki, or leading immersive sound healing experiences, Renee’s approach is grounded in compassion, presence, and genuine human connection. She believes that healing begins when we feel truly seen, heard, and supported.

Holding space is at the heart of everything Renee does. She is deeply passionate about helping others slow down, reconnect with their inner wisdom, release what no longer serves them, and return to a place of peace, self-love, and authenticity.

Renee welcomes people from all walks of life, offering a warm, non-judgmental environment where each individual is encouraged to move at their own pace and honour their own unique journey.

coaches.name: Carley Schroeder
coaches.specialties: Personal training · Hatha yoga · Functional nutrition
coaches.bio:
I’m Carley Schroeder — a Certified Personal Trainer, Hatha Yoga Teacher, Functional Nutrition Coach, Clairvoyant, mom of four, and Founder & CEO of Deeply Rooted Coaching.

With a background in Exercise Science and years of experience working with both men and women, I’ve built my work around one simple belief: when you take care of the whole person, everything changes.

My approach to health goes far beyond workouts and nutrition. I combine movement, functional nutrition, mindset, nervous system regulation, body awareness, and holistic healing to help people reconnect with themselves and become the strongest, healthiest, most vibrant version of who they are.

Throughout my career, I’ve had the privilege of working with individuals and couples, helping them build healthier relationships with their bodies, their health, and ultimately themselves. I’ve seen firsthand how profoundly our physical health, confidence, emotional wellbeing, and the way we show up in our relationships can influence every area of our lives.

As a mom of four, I also understand the importance of building a life and a body that support the life you actually want to live. I built Deeply Rooted Coaching while raising my children, creating a coaching philosophy rooted in sustainable health, personal growth, and whole-person transformation.

Outside of my work, you’ll find me enjoying the natural beauty of Hawaiʻi with my husband and kids — swimming, hiking, spending time at the beach, working out, exploring, and soaking up as much time in nature as possible.

My passion is helping people feel at home in their bodies, reconnect with who they are, and create a life where they feel strong, confident, grounded, and fully alive.
coaches.image_alt: Carley Schroeder, Primal Reset retreat coach

coaches.name: Priscilla
coaches.specialties: Trauma-informed counselling · Breathwork · Reiki · Energy healing
coaches.bio:
Priscilla is a trauma-informed healer, counsellor, and breathwork facilitator who creates safe, compassionate spaces for deep healing and personal transformation. Her work integrates transformational breathwork, Reiki, energy healing, spiritual guidance, and trauma-informed counselling to support the mind, body, and spirit.

With a warm yet grounded approach, Priscilla is passionate about helping people explore the deeper layers beneath their emotions, release what no longer serves them, and reconnect with their own inner strength and truth. She believes that meaningful transformation begins when we feel genuinely seen, heard, and supported—without judgement.

Priscilla holds space with both compassion and strength, supporting others to navigate difficult emotions, develop greater self-awareness, and create a more authentic and empowered relationship with themselves and others.

coaches.name: Zoë Howse
coaches.specialties: Former registered nurse · Breathwork · Consciousness coaching · Yoga
coaches.bio:
Zoë Howse is a Breathwork Coach, Consciousness Coach, Yoga Teacher, Personal Trainer and former Registered Nurse, passionate about helping people reconnect with themselves and create more joy, empowerment and balance in their lives.

After more than twelve years in nursing, Zoë felt called towards a more holistic way of supporting people — one that works with the body, breath and inner world, rather than focusing solely on symptoms. This led her to train in yoga, life coaching, personal training, energy healing and transformational breathwork.

Today, through Flowstate with Zoë, she guides both group and 1:1 experiences designed to support meaningful personal growth and transformation.

Zoë’s mission is simple: to help people heal, grow and become the best version of themselves. She believes true wellbeing begins from within, and her work encourages greater self-awareness, self-worth, empowerment and presence in everyday life.

In her breathwork sessions, Zoë creates a supportive and grounded space for people to slow down, turn inward and reconnect with themselves. Through intentional breathing practices, participants are guided to regulate the nervous system, release built-up tension and emotion, and create space for greater clarity, connection and balance — mentally, emotionally and physically.

Her approach is practical and deeply human. Each experience combines guided practice with space to integrate, alongside simple tools participants can take home and continue using.

For Zoë, the goal isn’t simply to feel good during a session — it’s to give people tools that support the way they live, feel and show up in their everyday lives.
